# 服务配图记录

生成方式：内置 image_gen（imagegen 技能），四张独立图片。
用途：服务概念配图，不代表客户委托或已交付案例。
统一画面：16:9，写实商业摄影，暖灰、米白、石墨黑、橙色，精细纸张及材料质感，无客户标识。

提示词组：
- social.png：Premium editorial product-mockup photograph of a modern smartphone and coordinated social editorial cards, expressive orange and charcoal abstract layouts, tactile paper and aluminum, soft directional light, no readable text or logos.
- data.png：Premium editorial photograph of tactile report sheets with black and orange charts and translucent orange acrylic bars, warm gray surface, realistic print textures, restrained composition, no brands or readable text.
- events.png：Premium architectural photograph of an unoccupied contemporary conference venue with orange/off-white graphic backdrop, graphite stage and matching wayfinding panels, soft daylight, no brands or readable text.
- assets.png：Premium editorial still life of an open corporate art book, graphite brochure, presentation cards and tablet, embossed geometric artwork, orange dividers, tactile paper and natural side light, no logos or readable text.
